name: Definitive Retexture Immersion Project (DRIP)
teaser: DRIP opens it's arms to you - now a core mod, DRIP makes it easy to add your own content to the game.
description_html:
Description

The next evolution of DRIP.

Now a lightweight mod made to be expanded upon by you, DRIP Core no longer adds it’s own items, instead simply adding 2 custom traders, and the ability to (relatively) easily add your own custom retextured gear into standalone “packs”, and share them among the community.

THIS MOD NO LONGER CONTAINS ANY GEAR OR CLOTHES BY DEFAULT!

Features overview:

  • Introduces our brand new and innovative “pack system”, bringing with it a new era of sharing custom gear and clothes for the SPT AKI community. Gone are the days of complicated folder structures and keeping track of multiple files for just 1 item, instead now all that’s needed is the item bundle itself, and a single .json5 file alongside it. That’s it! Adding your own custom retextured items to tarkov has never been easier!
  • Adds 2 traders who will sell all your custom items. Moron, who you should all already be familiar with, will specialize in iconic pre-2000s camouflage patterns, and any civilian or eccentric clothes he can find in the ULTRA mall. And it turns out black market dealing runs in the family, since now his younger sister Georgia is joining the trader roster. Being much more of a military nerd than her brother, she plans to sell more modern and commercial patterns currently in use by military around the globe.
Install Instructions

If you already have the original DRIP mod installed, please ensure that you delete your existing “ColetteBlackpaw-DRIP” folder entirely!

Download the latest version

Extract the contents of the archive

Drag and drop the ColetteBlackpaw-DRIP folder into your user/mods directory

Done!

Compatible Packs

FEATURED: DRIP Legacy Collection

Config

Configuration options are located within DRIP\config\config.json5. This can be edited with any basic text editor or IDE.

NoClothingRequirements:false by default. Makes all clothing free from Tupitsa and Georgia, also removing any quest completion requirement(s).

AddClothingToBots:true by default. Determines whether DRIP clothing will be added to the bot generation clothing pools. Setting this to false will also disable the tag system.

AddEquipmentToBots:true by default. Determines whether DRIP equipment will be added to the bot generation equipment pools.

UseDRIPTagSystem: true by default. DRIP includes a custom bot generation feature for selecting matching bot clothing. Each piece of clothing has a set of tags, where a matching set of clothing has a chance to be selected for an AI. Currently this feature is only applicable to PMC’s and some boss followers. Setting this to false will add clothing to the base game bot generation system.

VanillaClothingPricePercentage:100 by default. Percentage of the original cost of vanilla items. Can be used either for discounts or increased prices. Cannot be lower than 0.

vanillaclothing: true by default. Applies tags to vanilla clothing and adds them to the DRIP tag selection system.

CollectionInDescription: true by default. Adds the name of the collection that an item is from to its description.

DebugNames: false by default. Adds the name of the collection that an item is from to its name. Used primarily for debug.
